title: mq.doctor-status.v1
description: Output of `mqlaunch doctor --json`: the dependency and environment checks macos-scripts runs, with a summary and the next manual step. Read by mq-hal (brief, doctor summary, fix planner). Closed: a new key or status value is a contract change, not a silent addition.

version.description: Contents of VERSION, or `unknown` when it cannot be read.

status.description: Worst check status: `fail` if any check failed, else `warn` if any warned, else `ok`.

detail.description: What was observed, for a check that did not pass.

hint.description: A one-line manual fix, when a safe one is known. Never executed by doctor.

next.description: The next manual step, or null when there is none.
